newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano says no knowledge of stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Giordano says no knowledge of stake sale.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd said on Wednesday the company directors had no knowledge of any stake in the company being sold to the Everbright Group.

"They have no knowledge of any such purchase (including the identity of the vendor) nor has the company received any notification...indicating that such purchase has taken place," the company said in a statement.
Giordano said it made the statement in response to press reports the Everbright Group had bought a stake from an unnamed shareholder representing 20 percent of the company's share capital.
